newsitem.title: USA: Tricord Systems lowers server prices.
newsitem.headline: Tricord Systems lowers server prices.

text.p: Tricord Systems Inc said Tuesday it cut prices by 20 to 35 percent on all its PowerFrame Enterprise Server configurations and add-ons, effective immediately.
Continuing improvements in manufacturing management processes and component cost reductions enabled the company to cut prices to customers, it added.
Tricord is also offering customers competitive pricing on entry-level configurations.

"Tricord has significantly lowered prices for processors and memory to make Tricord's proven solutions available to a larger market segment," Skip Duggan, vice president of product marketing, said in a statement.
Tricord also announced specially priced two- and four-processor Enterprise Access packages to run application development software from several industry partners.
